## Scope and authority
- What goal does this change advance?
- Which PPIO rules, canon and decisions apply?
- Does it affect story, combat timing, geography, controller UX, rigs, audio, or the design language? If yes, link the relevant impact review.

## R1: no destructive changes
- [ ] Root/remote/branch and working state checked
- [ ] Existing OMP/Goose/user work and history preserved
- [ ] Changes are narrow, reversible, and a backup/revert path exists
- [ ] No unapproved content/license/secret exposure
- [ ] No silent canon or approved mechanic change

## R2: system and user protected
- [ ] No unapproved heavy GPU work while user active
- [ ] Resource/idle safety preserved, tests appropriately bounded
- [ ] No duplicate server, competing model, unexpected service or unsafe install

## R3: deliver and recover
- [ ] Blocking dependencies documented with safe fallback
- [ ] Verified work reused; no unnecessary re-generation
- [ ] Actual completion gate and next safe action described

## Originality and quality — mandatory for visual, game-feel or audio changes
- [ ] Linked identity/contrast review or reason genuinely not applicable
- [ ] At least three **observable** design commitments, not vague adjectives
- [ ] Compared against the nearest two existing designs; no recolor-only difference
- [ ] Playable/articulated/sonic distinctions demonstrated, including appropriate screenshots or captures
- [ ] Generic AI patterns, copy-paste motion/combat/HUD, and protected-source imitation rejected
- [ ] Rigging, animation, socket, UI, VFX and audio events validated where affected
- [ ] Distinguish ACCEPTED FOR SLICE from final owner art/canon approval

## Scope and pacing — for section/encounter changes
- [ ] Section record references physical geography and toy POV
- [ ] Duration, encounter density, battle length and player fatigue accounted for
- [ ] Provisional numeric targets marked TEST_ONLY / TBD unless owner-approved
- [ ] Meaningful encounter variation and return-route continuity checked

## Evidence
- Tested commands/results:
- Real controller/visual/audio test performed by:
- NOT TESTED and BLOCKED items:
- Asset/license/source provenance:
- Rollback procedure:
- Owner approvals still needed:
